name: PassMaster — Restaurant Kitchen & Table Service
description: Front-of-house and kitchen pass for small restaurants: take reservations, run the floor and table status, fire kitchen tickets by course, work the prep list, and close the shift. Includes 6 forms and 1 app.

packMeta.name: PassMaster — Restaurant Kitchen & Table Service
packMeta.description: A front-of-house and kitchen hub for small restaurants: take reservations, work the floor by table, fire and track kitchen tickets down the pass, run the prep board station by station, and close out each night with covers and sales.
packMeta.author: FormLogic

forms.title: Staff Member
forms.description: Add a member of the brigade with their role, section or station and contact number.

fields.label: New Staff Member
fields.description: Add your servers, chefs and bar team so you can assign tables, tickets and prep.

forms.title: Reservation
forms.description: Take a booking with the guest, date, time, party size, table preference and status.

fields.label: New Reservation
fields.description: Note who is coming in, when, and how many so the floor is ready for them.

properties.placeholder: Occasion, high chair, allergies, regular guest…

forms.title: Table
forms.description: Set up a table with its section, capacity, current service stage and the server on it.

fields.label: New Table
fields.description: Lay out the room table by table so you can track service across the floor.

properties.placeholder: Anything the floor should know about this table…

forms.title: Kitchen Ticket
forms.description: Fire a ticket to the kitchen with its table, course, items, allergy notes and status down the pass.

fields.label: New Kitchen Ticket
fields.description: Send an order to the pass so the line knows what to cook and in what order.

properties.placeholder: 2x steak frites, 1x market fish, hold the butter…

forms.title: Prep Item
forms.description: Add a prep task with its station, quantity, unit, due time and who it is assigned to.

fields.label: New Prep Item
fields.description: Build the prep list station by station so the kitchen is ready for service.

forms.title: Shift Close
forms.description: Close out the night with covers served, sales, voids and comps, incidents and the cleaning checklist.

fields.label: Nightly Shift Close
fields.description: Record how the night went so the numbers and the handover are ready for tomorrow.

properties.placeholder: Anything worth flagging from the shift…

apps.name: PassMaster
apps.description: A restaurant service hub: take reservations, run the floor by table, fire and track kitchen tickets down the pass, work the prep board and close out each night with covers and sales.

roles.name: Manager
roles.description: Full access to every PassMaster form.

roles.name: Server
roles.description: Front-of-house staff who take bookings, work the floor and fire tickets.

roles.name: Kitchen
roles.description: Back-of-house staff who cook tickets down the pass and run the prep board.

reports.name: Reservations by status
reports.description: Count of reservations broken down by their current status.

reports.name: Tickets by course
reports.description: Count of kitchen tickets grouped by course.

reports.name: Sales recorded
reports.description: Total sales summed across all shift closes.

reports.name: Tickets by server
reports.description: Count of kitchen tickets grouped by the linked server.

reports.name: Service and pass overview
reports.description: High-level summary of reservations, kitchen activity and nightly sales.

blocks.title: Service and pass overview
blocks.body: This report summarises how the restaurant is trading: reservation volume and mix, what the kitchen is cooking by course and by server, and the sales recorded at each nightly close. Use it to spot busy services, balance the line and keep an eye on revenue.

blocks.caption: Total sales across all shift closes.
